name: Manaka de Ikuno!!
source: Introductory VN and launcher for games in [url=/r5841]Manaka de Iku no!! ~Leaf Amusement Soft Vol.5[/url] which includes [url=/v33943]Mananatsu[/url], [url=/v33944]Final Dragon Chronicle: Guilty Requiem[/url], and two other non-VN games. Features conversation between Manaka and Ikuno.
